scenario.title: A release that ships more than one project
situations: One application release embeds another project
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: No linked release was executed; confirm each consumer build and exact candidate proof when adopting this topology.

lessons.title: Related projects are not automatically one release
lessons.when: A second related project appears or a change spans repositories
lessons.need: Keep one item per project with linked companion work. Identify whether the relationship is dependency only or whether one actual build ships both sources; matching names or a general relationship grants no completion authority.
lessons.surface: JOURNEYS row 14; delivery binding rules and public item-bound delivery.
lessons.gap: Runtime supports bound sources, but a short guided linking/adoption home is still needed. Do not auto-create shared deployment bindings for every related project.

lessons.title: Read the exact shipped source for each project
lessons.when: Configuring or starting shared release, then retrying it
lessons.need: A workflow input_binding names a registered project branch; composition freezes one commit per project and enrolls work actually shipped. Completion is per-project exact source. Stale/unreachable bindings refuse with repair; do not silently rebind a running release.
lessons.surface: delivery.md binding-based multi-project delivery lines 11–87; flow runner contract.
lessons.gap: The future entry should route to this real mechanism and its source-access prerequisites. Item dependency and delivery-source evidence remain distinct.
